jobs.name: todo-digest
jobs.prompt: Trigger the morning to-do digest. POST to https://custom-to-do-app-production.up.railway.app/api/organize?unprocessedOnly=true (no body needed). The endpoint classifies unprocessed items with Claude and posts a Block Kit digest to Slack #brain-dump itself — partitioned with #top items under a 🔴 Priority header, others under 📋 Other new items. After the request returns, check the JSON in this order: (1) if HTTP status != 200, reply 'Digest endpoint error: <status>'. (2) Else if a `slack` array exists and any entry has ok !== true, reply 'Digest classified N items but Slack post failed: <error codes from failing entries>' — this means #brain-dump never got the post. (3) Otherwise reply with the `message` field (e.g. '5 new items captured' or 'No new ideas since last organize'). Under 40 words. Atlas voice — no hype.

jobs.name: scraper-suite-heartbeat
jobs.prompt:
Check whether the scraper-suite scrapers ran on cadence.

Query the scraper-suite Supabase project's REST API. Base URL is in env var SCRAPER_SUITE_SUPABASE_URL; the service-role key needed for auth is in env var SCRAPER_SUITE_SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY (Supabase REST convention: same key goes in both the `apikey` request header and the standard auth header). Pick whichever HTTP tool you have available. Endpoint path:

  /rest/v1/pipeline_runs?select=scraper,status,created_at,run_at,error_msg&order=created_at.desc&limit=200

Note the query is NOT filtered to successes — you need the error rows too (see the failed-attempt rule below).

Never echo the key value back into Slack output. If the request fails (network, auth, etc.), reply `Scrapers: heartbeat-check failed — <one-line reason>` and stop.

For each of these scrapers, find the most-recent success and compute age from now:
  - craigslist            (expected every 12h, alert if > 16h since last success)
  - stl_city_violations   (expected weekly,  alert if > 8d  since last success)
  - stl_vacant            (expected weekly,  alert if > 8d  since last success)
  - casenet               (expected weekly,  alert if > 8d  since last success)
  - stl_sheriff_tax_sale  (expected weekly,  alert if > 8d  since last success)
  - stl_csb_311           (expected weekly,  alert if > 8d  since last success)
  - jefferson_foreclosure (expected weekly,  alert if > 8d  since last success)
  - auto_push             (expected Mon-Sat, alert if > 52h since last success)

auto_push is the daily trace-and-push of leads into Close — the only job that spends Tracerfy credits and sends SMS to real sellers, so treat it as the highest-signal entry. It does NOT run Sunday, so a Monday check legitimately shows ~47h; that is why its tolerance is 52h and not 36h.

FAILED-ATTEMPT RULE (applies to all eight): if a scraper's most recent row is status='error' — even when an older success is still inside tolerance — report it as overdue with its `error_msg`. A job erroring every run still looks green under a pure staleness check, which is how auto_push pushed ~0 leads for three days (2026-07-17/18/20) while the heartbeat stayed quiet.

If ALL eight are within tolerance AND none has an errored most-recent row, reply exactly: `Scrapers: all 8 green (freshest: <name>, <age>; oldest: <name>, <age>).`

If ANY are overdue, reply with `⚠ <@U03H98ETATE> scraper heartbeat — overdue:` followed by one bullet per overdue scraper: `• <scraper> — last ran <YYYY-MM-DD> (<X>d/<Xh> ago, expected <cadence>). <remediation>`. Remediation hints:
  - craigslist: check `crontab -l` on the Mac or `npm run scrape:craigslist`
  - stl_city_violations / stl_vacant: `npm run weekly` on the Mac (probably missed Monday 8am — Mac was asleep)
  - casenet: `python3 scrapers/casenet/run_weekly.py --casenet-only` on the Mac
  - stl_sheriff_tax_sale: `npm run scrape:tax-sale` on the Mac. Most days expect a success-with-records=0 heartbeat (no new sales). Overdue here often means the parent-page scrape broke (Sheriff HTML changed) — check `logs/sheriff-tax-sale.log`.
  - stl_csb_311: `npm run scrape:csb` on the Mac (probably missed Monday 6am — Mac was asleep). Weekly cadence, expects ~12 new leads/mo steady-state.
  - auto_push: check `logs/auto_push.log` on the Mac. By far the most common cause is Tracerfy credits hitting zero — the `error_msg` will say so explicitly, and the fix is for Erik to top up at tracerfy.com (nothing to re-run; the next 8am fire recovers on its own). Otherwise the dashboard on localhost:3000 is down. To catch up manually: `bash scripts/run_auto_push.sh` on the Mac, but ONLY between 8:45am and 5:45pm CT — day-0 SMS fires ~1h after each push and must land inside the comms window.
  - jefferson_foreclosure: `python3 scrapers/casenet/run_jefferson_sheriff.py` on the Mac. JCSD lists ~6 weeks ahead of each Thursday auction; steady state is `{"allSales": []}` → success-with-records=0. Lumpy by design — empty for weeks then a 5-20 sale wave. Overdue most often means the dmxConnect endpoint moved — check `logs/jefferson-sheriff.log`.

If anything is overdue, ALSO DM Erik (Slack user U03H98ETATE) with the same overdue list using whichever Slack send tool is available. If no DM tool is available, the `<@U03H98ETATE>` mention in the #chief reply will push-notify him on mobile — that's the fallback.

Under 200 words. Atlas voice — no hype, no apology. No emoji except the leading ⚠ when overdue.

jobs.name: code-standup
jobs.prompt: Post a morning code standup to Slack #chief. Pull source data live from GitHub via the github MCP — Erik's username is `eriksilver`. Steps: (1) Call mcp_github_search_repositories with `user:eriksilver` to enumerate his repos. (2) For each repo, call mcp_github_list_commits with `since` set to yesterday 00:00 Central (US/Chicago) and `until` set to today 00:00 Central — skip repos with no commits in that window. (3) Format the post: one-line greeting → `Yesterday:` (group by repo, one-line per commit, leading bullet, short subject only, skip merge commits) → `Queued / planned:` (pull from todo-app `mcp_todo_app_list_dev_projects` where status is `active`; if none active, say `Nothing queued.`) → one dry one-line observation about momentum or focus. Under 250 words. Atlas voice — no hype, no apology, no emoji.

jobs.name: todo-briefing
jobs.script:
tmp=$(mktemp)
code=$(curl -sS -o "$tmp" -w '%{http_code}' -X POST --max-time 150 https://custom-to-do-app-production.up.railway.app/api/briefing/run 2>/dev/null)
if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
  echo "⚠ Daily briefing cron failed — HTTP ${code:-000} (no briefing generated; no push sent). $(head -c 200 "$tmp" 2>/dev/null)"
fi
rm -f "$tmp"
